title: PortZone index
description: ports.json: every listed port. Added by pull request; the port's own portzone.json, if it has one, adds the rest.

id.description: Unique name. Sphaira keys installs by it; the default install folder is /switch/<id>.

url.description: The port's GitHub repository, exactly https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.

manifest.description: The port's portzone.json in its repository, as a path from the repository root. Default portzone.json. Set it when one repository makes several games (one listing each, each with its own file, like portzone/tmodloader.json).

description.description: One or two sentences: what the game is and what the player must bring. Used when portzone.json has no description.

icon.description: Square HTTPS PNG or JPEG, 256x256 or larger, at most 1 MB. Used when the port has no portzone.json icon. Omitted: the repository owner's GitHub avatar.

banner.description: Wide HTTPS PNG or JPEG, 16:9 (1280x720), at most 2 MB. Used when the port has no portzone.json banner.

platform.description: Used when the port has no portzone.json platform.
